```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

cups = pd.read_csv("worldcups.csv")
```

```{python}
#| label: brazil-titles
#| include: false

#sort by year; keeping only tournaments Brazil won
cups = cups.sort_values("year")
brazil = cups[cups["winner"] == "Brazil"]
```

## Attendance Over Time

@fig-attendance-over-time refers toi total attendance at each World Cup (in thousands) from 1930 to 2022.

```{python}
#| label: fig-attendance-over-time
#| fig-cap: "Total World Cup Attendance Over Time (thousands)"

plt.plot(cups["year"], cups["attendance_k"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Total attendance (thousands)")
plt.show()
```

The dataset covers `{python} len(cups)` tournaments, and Brazil won `{python} len(brazil)` of them.
